name: video-pip
note: Rounds 9-12 (operator UAT 2026-08-10/13). THREE video states, ONE element, the iframe never remounts (audio never dies). Round 12's law: the video layer is DECOUPLED from the Studio ('I don't want to switch to the solo view') - expanding the PIP goes to the THEATER card floating over WHATEVER screen you are on, and minimizing returns you exactly there. The PIP wears a visible maximize bar on top ('a button on top to maximize to theater view because clicking the skip after an ad won't be possible in a small pip' - taps in theater reach the embed, so Skip lives there); the theater wears its minimize bar on the bottom; the park handle rides the PIP's left edge; the bar's LEFT zone (eq + title/meta) toggles the dock both ways, session-sticky. The Studio door is the playing row's details chip (openStudio is idempotent - expands, never rebuilds). Plus round 9's scrub (synthesized infoDelivery) and refocus honesty (synthetic visibilitychange). Native requestPictureInPicture is unreachable for a cross-origin YT iframe - the PIP is a CSS overlay by design.

steps.label: ROW-TAP PLAY -> the PIP shows immediately (min, fixed, docked above the bar) wearing its MAXIMIZE bar on top and the park handle on its LEFT edge; iframe fingerprinted for the never-remounts proof
steps.js: (function(){var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||!m.classList.contains('min'))return false;if(getComputedStyle(m).position!=='fixed')return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width>130&&r.width<170&&r.height>90&&r.height<120))return false;var bar=document.querySelector('.bt-st-head').getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.bottom<=bar.top+2))return false;var tx=document.querySelector('[data-thmax]');if(!tx)return false;var txr=tx.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(txr.height>14&&txr.height<26&&txr.top-r.top<3&&txr.width>100))return false;var h=document.querySelector('[data-piphide]');if(!h)return false;var hr=h.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(hr.width>=24&&hr.height>=44&&hr.right<=r.left&&r.left-hr.right<14))return false;var f=m.querySelector('iframe');if(!f)return false;window.__pipFrame=f;return true;})()

steps.label: MAXIMIZE -> THEATER OVER THE LIBRARY: the card floats over the CURRENT screen - the player is STILL mini (no Studio/solo switch), fixed centered card, NO click-catcher (taps reach the embed - Skip is tappable here), same iframe, the card's minimize bar at its bottom, the PIP's maximize bar gone with the PIP
the card's minimize bar returns to the PIP - still over the library (still mini), park handle back
PARK: the handle collapses the PIP INTO the bar title - media zero-size but the SAME iframe stays connected (audio alive), player wears .vidhid, the title grows the video cue
UN-PARK: a left-zone tap brings the PIP back WITHOUT any view switch
TOGGLE both ways: the same left-zone tap PARKS the showing PIP again, still mini, audio-alive iframe untouched
SCRUB (in mini): synthesize the embed's duration report, then pointer-drag the progress bar to ~60% - the fill tracks the finger and lands at 60, same iframe untouched
steps.js: (function(){window.dispatchEvent(new MessageEvent('message',{data:JSON.stringify({event:'infoDelivery',info:{duration:100,currentTime:10}})}));var p=document.querySelector('[data-npprog]');if(!p)return false;var r=p.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.width>0))return false;var x0=r.left+r.width*0.2,x1=r.left+r.width*0.6,y=r.top+r.height/2;function ev(type,x){p.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type,{pointerId:7,clientX:x,clientY:y,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));}ev('pointerdown',x0);ev('pointermove',x1);ev('pointerup',x1);var now=parseInt(p.getAttribute('aria-valuenow'),10);var w=parseFloat(document.querySelector('[data-npfill]').style.width);return now===60 && Math.abs(w-60)<2 && document.querySelector('.bt-st-media iframe')===window.__pipFrame;})()

steps.label: REFOCUS HONESTY: a visibility return while marked playing flips the bar to PAUSED (play glyph, npPaused class) - backgrounding always pauses the embed, the bar must never lie
the STUDIO DOOR is the playing row's details chip - idempotent open (same iframe, never rebuilt), the PIP rides along intact, menu offers Expand video

PIP body tap = theater too, here floating over the STUDIO (still open behind - no navigation), bar pp stays visible (constant shape), menu reads Minimize video, countdown (if live) fully BELOW the card; countdown cancelled for determinism
steps.js: (function(){var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(!p.classList.contains('vidopen')||p.classList.contains('mini'))return false;if(document.querySelector('[data-vidmin]'))return false;var m=document.querySelector('.bt-st-media');if(!m||m.classList.contains('min')||m.classList.contains('hid'))return false;var r=m.getBoundingClientRect();if(m.querySelector('iframe')!==window.__pipFrame)return false;var pp=document.querySelector('.bt-player [data-nppp]');if(!pp||pp.offsetParent===null)return false;var vt=document.querySelector('[data-vidtoggle]');if(!vt||vt.textContent.trim()!=='Minimize video')return false;var cd=document.querySelector('[data-countdown]');if(cd&&!cd.classList.contains('done')){var cr=cd.getBoundingClientRect();if(cr.top<r.bottom-2)return false;}var k=document.querySelector('[data-keepopen]');if(k)k.click();return true;})()
